{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Convert `converted` to boolean for clarity
sales_df['converted'] = sales_df['converted'].astype(bool)

# Check for sentinel values: customer_age = -1
print("Customer age -1 count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded order count:", (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check segment distribution
print("Segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if channel and segment are confounded
print("Channel vs Segment cross-tab:\n", pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))"}
